evidenceRules: A source mapping is not a runtime pass.
A build is not visual or physical-device acceptance.
Not applicable needs an actual scope/capability reason; lack of access is Not executed.
Every pass records candidate commit, environment, device or browser, date and inspectable evidence.
Reuse unchanged-owner evidence only with commit/configuration/platform relevance.
